ideas.title: Minneapolis new liquor licenses by snapshot-diffing On_Sale_Liquor licenseNumber
ideas.why: The ArcGIS layer's issueDate includes renewals and there is no original-issue date; a licenseNumber not seen in yesterday's full snapshot (654 rows) is a genuinely new place. Needs a small stateful diff step (first-seen date per license).

ideas.title: Keep openings visible for N days after their license date (build.py window for kind=opening)
ideas.why: build.load_live_records drops records whose end < now-2h, so every opening dated in the past (most license signals) never reaches the export: Denver exports 0 events, NYC exports none of its 1,216 opening records. Openings need a display window (e.g. 60 days after start) instead of a fabricated end date.
